title: angelica hendersonii
intro: Angelica hendersonii, commonly known as Henderson's angelica, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae) native to New Zealand. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antibacterial agent. The therapeutic actions of Henderson's angelica include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Henderson's angelica have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities, contributing to its potential health benefits.
